answer: Bind each identity to an onyx chain: the newcomer's work is split into short signed threads, each countersigned by random established peers before the next can begin, so rewards arrive only at the end of a long, personally-earned chain. Two independent graders flagging one thread as copied - the old fable that cloning is cheap - snaps the whole chain back to zero. Graders stake reputation on every signature, so colluders sink together. A Sybil farmer must hand-craft an entire chain per fake identity, every link inspected by strangers, making mass fakes cost more than the rewards they chase.
